key_expressions: What kind of style do you like?,
I like things that are light and comfortable.,

A: I like bright colors like this. What color do you like?
Oh wow, our tastes are more similar than I thought!
Then let’s go shopping together next time!
B: I usually like pastel colors!
Right! Our color preferences are almost the same!
Sure! That sounds fun.

A: I like sweet flavors. How about you?
Oh! I really like that combination too!
Then let’s go eat it together sometime!
B: I prefer something a bit tangy rather than sweet!
A mix of sweet and fresh tastes is perfect!
Sounds good! I’m looking forward to it!

A: I prefer quiet cafés. What about you?
Yeah, I also struggle in really noisy places.
Then let’s go to a quiet one next time!
B: I like cafés with a nice atmosphere too.
Exactly! It helps you focus and relax.
Sure! I’ll look for a good place.

A: I like listening to light music when I exercise.
Ah, I totally get that!
Then I’ll share my playlist with you!
B: I like more energetic music!
Rhythmic music is perfect for workouts!
Nice! Please share it!

A: I like clothes that are light and comfortable.
Oh, our styles are pretty similar!
Then I think you’ll like that brand too!
B: I also prefer comfortable outfits!
Right, I’m not a fan of overly fancy looks.
Oh! I’ll check it out.

A: When I travel, I like places with natural scenery.
Oh, I also prefer nature over cities!
Then let’s recommend some places to each other!
B: I feel so good when I see the ocean.
Nature is much more healing!
Great! I already have a few places in mind.

A: I don’t really like strong scents.
Right, something soft is much nicer!
Then try that brand!
B: I also find strong scents overwhelming.
A strong smell can be tiring after a while.
Oh! Thanks for the recommendation.

A: For movies, I prefer something light.
Oh, same here! Heavy movies can be hard to watch often.
Then I’ll recommend a comedy for you!
B: I like thrillers too, but light movies are great as well!
Right! Light movies are perfect when you just want to relax.
Sounds great! I’ll look forward to it.

A: I like staying home and relaxing on weekends.
I totally relate!
Then let’s relax together next weekend!
B: Same here. Staying home is the best for me lately.
It feels like your mind and body can finally rest!
Sounds good! Let’s meet comfortably then!

A: I don’t really like overly decorative designs.
Oh, I also prefer simple ones!
Then check out that brand!
B: Yeah, too flashy can feel overwhelming.
Simple designs last longer too!
Great! I’ll look it up right away.
